title: Conjunction at the terminal condition
statement: Let $A$, $B$, and $	ext{Kont}$ be predicates on the natural numbers, let $Q$ be a proposition, and let $r,t,c$ be natural numbers. The recursive condition that makes $r$ choices between $A$ and $B$, ending with the condition $	ext{Kont}(c')\land Q$, holds at $(r,t,c)$ if and only if the same recursive condition ending with $	ext{Kont}(c')$ holds there and $Q$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: Predicates A, B, and Kont on natural numbers
Natural numbers r, t, and c
